title: Create Anything AI Stack Catalog
description: Validates stacks/catalog.json, the canonical index of proposed stack combinations. Structural rules that JSON Schema cannot express (exact stack count, globally unique IDs, contiguous numbering, ID/number agreement) are enforced by the catalog validator.

maturityPolicy.description: The complete, ordered set of allowed maturity values. Every stack maturity must be a member of this list.

categoryPolicy.description: The complete set of allowed category slugs. Every stack category must be a member of this list.

maturity.description: Maturity states accepted by the repository quality gates. A stack only advances after its gate evidence is recorded.

category.description: Machine-readable category slugs used in catalog.json, stack manifests, and documentation tables.

stackId.description: Two-digit number prefix followed by lowercase alphanumeric segments; must agree with the entry's number.
